primary_question: Does the funding + price-dislocation feature set improve out-of-sample forecasts of a realized-volatility STRESS event (next-24h realized variance exceeding an expanding, train-only high quantile per coin) beyond a realized-volatility-only baseline on the broad ironflow_bulk panel?

design.target: stress event y_t = 1 if RV_{t+1..t+24} > q_t
design.rv_definition: trailing 24h realized variance from hourly close-to-close log returns
design.threshold_q_t: expanding, train-only per-coin high quantile (0.95) of trailing RV, shifted by 1 (no future info)
design.candidate: RV-only + signed funding_rate + abs(funding_rate) + premium + mark/EMA24 distance

materiality_definition: candidate relative Brier improvement over the RV-only baseline must exceed 0.02 (2%); verdict is symmetric PROMOTED / NOT_SUPPORTED

verdict_rule.PROMOTED: materiality_met is True AND candidate beats baseline on Brier (Holm-adjusted)
verdict_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: materiality floor not met (valid, publishable negative result)

universe: coins present in candles_1h AND funding AND open_interest (intersection)
frozen_inputs_note: ironflow_bulk 18 monthly parquet per dataset; sha256-asserted; read-only
